أنزلق (form VII)
# أَنْزَلِقُ (ʔanzaliqu) /ʔan.za.li.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْزَلَقَ (inzalaqa)
# أَنْزَلِقَ (ʔanzaliqa) /ʔan.za.li.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْزَلَقَ (inzalaqa)
# أَنْزَلِقْ (ʔanzaliq) /ʔan.za.liq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْزَلَقَ (inzalaqa)
